scope: Read-only GGUF metadata/tensor descriptors; no inference, no tensor-body reads, no build; stdlib-only low-priority parser.
general_metadata_note: Other differences are descriptive authorship/provenance/license/dataset metadata newly read from the pinned source model card, the required derivative display name, and general.file_type for Q4 versus Q8. The complete delta is retained. License badges do not waive the accompanying inherited terms.

local_q4.value: Derived from ScribeKey Fast by ScribeKey (Freehand precision research)

precision_qualification: The verified original BF16 safetensors were converted to F16 then Q4_K_M. Tensor names/dimensions and architecture match publisher Q8; numerical tensor values are intentionally changed by quantization and were not exhaustively compared/dequantized in this audit.

template_explanation.publisher_card_statement: The evaluated GGUF retains an inherited LFM chat template; do not rely on its automatic chat formatting.
template_explanation.reason: Publisher Q8 retained inherited LFM chat formatting. The current pinned HF source includes the 305-character trained one-user-message task template, automatically embedded by the clean conversion. The local GGUF therefore contains the task template instead of the 5487-character inherited template.
template_explanation.raw_completion_qualification: Freehand ScribeKeyFast supplies the raw BOS/task/input/output prompt to /completion with --no-jinja. That bypasses Jinja message rendering, but it does not disable native tokenizer BOS/EOS/EOG handling or add-special-token behavior. The token IDs, token strings, vocabulary, token types and merge table match; the additional local add_eos=false field must be checked against the pinned runtime default.

native_default_add_eos_audit.qualification: The local explicit false flags add_eos and clean_spaces equal the official Q8 defaults under this exact b12015 runtime. No claim about another runtime version is inferred.

raw_completion_BOS_handling.contract: Specialist text is pretokenized with addSpecial=false and parse_special=true, then submitted as integer token IDs to /completion. This preserves exactly the single BOS token in the trained raw prompt and avoids b12015 automatic BOS addition to string completion prompts. Native EOS/EOG handling remains enabled.

distribution.limitation: This local Q4 has no publisher-hosted immutable download URL. Existing source artifact URLs resolve original safetensors/Q8, not these derived Q4 bytes. Local prepared-bundle selection can use verified local bytes; Settings acquisition requires an approved hosted immutable Q4 artifact with exact SHA/size and applicable notices, or a separately implemented reproducible local conversion flow. Nothing was published or uploaded.
distribution.settings_download_limitation: The local derived GGUF can be addressed by its prepared absolute-path manifest; actual managed/native runtime validation remains separately recorded. A production Settings download needs separately approved immutable hosting of these exact derived bytes and notices. Original HF source/Q8 URLs cannot substitute for a hosted Q4. No publishing/uploading occurred.

mixed_quantization_note: Q4_K_M is a mixed policy: 82 Q4_K, 11 Q6_K and 55 F32 tensors here, versus publisher Q8 with 93 Q8_0 and 55 F32 tensors. No importance matrix/calibration or vocabulary pruning was used. Emberon Q4 is separately pruned/calibrated, so this compares deployable candidates rather than isolating architecture/vocabulary/precision as one scientific factor.

startup_chat_template_audit.interpretation: The server contains a startup example formatter under SRV_TRC. LOG_TMPL guards argument evaluation before calling that formatter; with Freehand --log-disable the unsupported legacy template formatter is skipped. Raw token-array /completion does not call Jinja or legacy message rendering. Do not infer a required normal-startup failure from the trace statement.
startup_chat_template_audit.limitation: Calling legacy chat formatting with this task template, including enabling trace logging that evaluates the startup dummy multi-message example, can reject the unsupported template. An explicit known chat-template override could make that unused diagnostic route robust if needed, but none was applied in this read-only audit.
startup_chat_template_audit.prior_parent_message_correction: An intermediate static warning overstated normal startup failure before auditing logging macro evaluation; the guarded argument evaluation resolves that claim.
